blindSummary: An external July 2026 legal-risk assessment places this state in its top protective grouping: regional non-discrimination covering gender identity and shield/refuge protections enforceable against out-of-state actions; no state-specific negative finding beyond the shared federal layer (passport and airline-documentation policy). No state-unique finding beyond insurance-coverage details a visitor never encounters.
blindSourceSummaries: An anti-trans legal-risk assessment map for this country (July 2026 update, republished by advocacy media): grades every state's legislative risk for transgender adults; one state entered the map's top travel-warning category (a felony bathroom ban carrying up to 5 years - its fourth such state) and another rose into its criminalisation category; it catalogues the nationwide federal rollback (passport and legal-document barriers, funding withdrawals, Pride-crosswalk erasure) and several countries' advisories for trans travellers. This state is listed among the top protective grouping - states rated as having gone furthest in safeguarding transgender people's rights.

Equality-map project on transgender healthcare 'shield' laws (data as of Sept 2026): 16 states plus the capital district have shield laws and two more protect access by executive order, shielding trans people, their families and providers - including people who travel from states where care is banned - against out-of-state civil or criminal action. This state is among the shield-law states.
